title: Rig, retarget, and validate animation
description: A reversible, evidence-producing workflow for rig, retarget, and validate animation.

ordered_stages.action: Validate neutral pose, transforms, topology, scale, and skeleton requirements.
Create a candidate skeleton and skin weights on a copy.
Map bones, root motion, contacts, and animation curves.
Review deformations, foot sliding, penetration, loop continuity, and joint limits.
Test clips in engine with representative state transitions.

quality_gates.description: Verify rights, consent, code, weights, datasets, output terms, and generation provenance.
Validate formats and domain-specific technical constraints.
Check visual identity and temporal consistency across relevant views and frames.
Check memory, frame time, draw calls, load time, and asset budgets.
Run interaction and playability smoke tests in the target runtime.
Store screenshots, artifacts, logs, versions, and comparison evidence.
Require human approval before replacing any source or production asset.
Weights and deformations pass extreme-pose review.
Root motion, contacts, foot sliding, loop continuity, and state transitions pass.

fallbacks: Use a known compatible skeleton and manual weight cleanup.
Keep source motion and retarget only verified clips.
